narrative: Soft food by candle: the pottage bowl, the apple split and steaming, Gib's tail across the corner of the frame. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat at the board and did not move the bowl for the sake of the tail.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Laid his tail across the corner and stayed.

entities.name: the hall candle
entities.context: In photo: The board by candle
